date_last_updated.why: the OECD page gives 28 May for version 2.0 without the year; the year follows from the Ministerial in Paris dated 29 May 2026 in G7-04 sources. Evidence added so the year is quoted.

evidence.quote: On 28 May, the OECD launched version 2.0 of the Hiroshima AI Process (HAIP) Reporting Framework at an event organised by Tech7, on the margins of the G7 Digital and Tech Ministerial Meeting under the French G7 Presidency in Paris.
On Friday, May 29, 2026, the G7 Digital and Tech Ministerial Meeting was held in Paris, France.
